title: 多语言LLM在乌尔都语中的文化与语言缺陷研究
summary: 研究评估GPT-5.1、Qwen-3-Max、DeepSeek-3.1等LLM在低资源语言乌尔都语故事生成中的表现，构建93篇故事语料库并按九类错误标注。发现模型常犯基础语法语义错误，故事缺乏连贯性、存在不自然重复和普遍文化浅薄问题，少样本提示也难以解决文化与语境错误。
summary_en: This work evaluates multilingual LLMs (GPT-5.1, Qwen-3-Max, DeepSeek-3.1) on Urdu story generation, building a corpus of 93 stories annotated with a nine-label taxonomy. Findings show frequent basic grammar and semantic errors, incoherent narratives, unnatural repetition, and pervasive cultural shallowness, which few-shot prompting largely fails to fix.
